Labor induction with vaginal 25-µg tablets of misoprostol
cohort: 412 pregnant women with indication for labor induction
finding: Higher Bishop scores and previous vaginal delivery were the best predictors of successful labor induction with vaginal 25-µg tablets of misoprostol.
mod_finding: 69% of the pregnant women who underwent labor induction progressed to vaginal delivery, and 31% of the women progressed to cesarean section.
